facts.fact: Simon 向两个女孩讲解家宴惯例：通常是周六到周一，这次客人可以提前几天到。
facts.anchor: Simon explained to us that a house party was usually Saturday to Monday

facts.fact: 主人如今改用自助餐上菜，客人没了与他多谈的机会，说话者把这称作遗憾。
facts.anchor: serving it as a buffet, so one never has the chance to spend much time with him

facts.fact: 父亲不许 Simon 开 Hispano-Suiza，Martin 只肯借给他一辆 Austin Seven。
facts.anchor: My father had refused to let Simon take the Hispano-Suiza, but Martin was allowing him to drive the Austin Seven

facts.fact: 周二叙述者翻自己的衣橱挑出行装，Tamsin 拒绝参与这件事。
facts.anchor: I raided my wardrobe for anything I thought might be helpful for the trip. Tamsin refused to join in.

facts.fact: Simon 仔细检查叙述者的衣橱与五斗柜，还拆开了她从没费心看过的几个包裹。
facts.anchor: Simon carefully inspected the contents of my armoire and bureau

facts.fact: Simon 一个下午就给叙述者配齐了旅行装和两件晚礼服。
facts.anchor: In an afternoon, he had me kitted out

facts.fact: 出发前的周三早上，Simon 坚持让 Tamsin 试穿一件后背钉着一排小珍珠纽扣的午夜蓝裙子。
facts.anchor: he insisted that Tamsin try on a lustrous midnight-blue dress

facts.fact: Tamsin 骂了一声，大步走回自己的房间。
facts.anchor: With a curse, Tamsin stalked into her room
